baseline: The accepted product bundles themselves, as shipped, with no query-map, counter-authority or ranking machinery applied on top: this benchmark reads the artifact the jurist would actually see.

derived_from.accepted_audit_coverage_gap: results/audit/evaluation/CYCLE_38951152192_GATE.json (gate=PASS) names 'no map-geometry gate' as this lane's next NEW question

hypothesis: The bundles Product actually ships satisfy the five map-contract properties the Master Prompt calls minimum semantics: every cluster-assigned decision is enumerable through the membership the bundle ships, no coordinate cell piles up more than 1% of the decisions, the is_outlier flag is consistent with the shipped relations graph, cluster labels are written in the query's language, and every counter-authority is both selectable and reachable. If they do not, the visual layer cannot deliver what the product exists to deliver, independently of how good the answer or the retrieval is.
input_selection_disclosure: The input set is the COMPLETE inventory of accepted product bundles matching a mechanical inclusion rule (>= 50 decisions, >= 2 clusters, finite x/y on every row, path ascending). No bundle was picked, dropped or reordered after results were seen, and the sha256 of each input is pinned in the spec.
metrics_pinned: MAP::outlier_degree_consistent (mean outlier degree < mean other degree; empty graph = DEGENERATE = FAIL)
MAP::label_language_matches_query (>= 0.8 of clusters not unambiguously off-language)
MAP::counter_authority_selectable (all counter rows enumerable and un-stranded)
pre_freeze_disclosure: A FEASIBILITY RECONNAISSANCE preceded this freeze and is excluded from the claim-bearing verdict: three served-packet bundles (gate_packet/38839347028 de/fr/it) and the frontier RULES_GEOMETRY input list were scanned for cluster sizes, member_ids lengths, distinct rounded coordinates, origin pile-ups, counter_status counts, is_outlier counts and label texts, in order to decide WHETHER a map-contract benchmark was feasible and which Master-Prompt properties to gate. No gate bar was chosen to obtain a particular verdict, no gate was added or removed after execution, and the frozen bars are derived from the Master Prompt's minimum map semantics rather than from any observed number: max_coincident_cell_share=0.01 is a near-zero 'you must be able to pick it apart' bar, unreachable_count=0 and size_mismatch_count=0 are exact contract requirements, and label_language_min_share=0.8 is a majority-of-labels bar. The reconnaissance did reveal that the recon problems exist; that is why the gates were frozen to be decisive. The verdict that counts is the one produced by running the frozen spec over the whole inventory, and it is reported whatever it says.
